## Decisions

- Dataless (iCloud stub) files are never read by a content search or by duplicate hashing; there is no switch to read
  them.
- Find Files stops at 2,000,000 hits (and duplicate runs at 3,000,000 files) and says so in the summary line; Spotlight
  answers are read up to 1,000,000 paths.
- Regex budgets: 0.25 s per name for Find/Selection, 0.1 s per name for Multi-Rename, 2 s per piece of file text; after
  three timeouts of one pattern the rest of its items are answered "no match" / `<Error!>` at once. Any timeout is shown
  (Find summary note, Selection message, Multi-Rename preview message).
- Multi-Rename undo history: at most 50,000 renamed files are saved in all; the saved runs are always the newest ones
  without a gap, so a bigger newest run means nothing is saved (it still works in this session).
- Multi-Rename refuses list edits (move, remove, sort, next step, load names) while a run or Undo is under way.
- A run that gets its names from a list or typed text and would move files into other folders asks for confirmation
  (default behaviour in tests: the scripted answer).
- `SelectionPlugin(pasteboard:background:)`: `background: false` keeps everything synchronous (used by the Selection
  tests); the default (the app) works long lists, regex masks, Compare Directories and the clipboard in the background.
  Lists up to 20,000 items without a regex stay synchronous.
- Invert/restore on lists over 20,000 items use the marks as a set of names (two names that read the same count as one);
  below that the exact kernel calls are used.
- The Multi-Rename log is written to `~/Library/Logs/<product>/`.

## Tests

New: `Tests/PluginTests/Review2FindFilesTests.swift` (16 tests), `Review2FindSelectionTests.swift` (11),
`Review2FindRenameTests.swift` (19). Changed existing tests: `SelectionMoreTests.swift` and `ToolsAdoptTests.swift`
(Selection bench built with `background: false`), `FindRenameFixRenameTests.swift` (`isSameFile` of a missing target is
now false), `MultiRenamePluginTests.swift` (answers the new confirmation of names that move files),
`MultiRenameEngineTests.swift` (the `[u]` check compares scalars). Final run in the project tree
(`swift test --scratch-path .build-find --filter "Review2Find|FindFiles|MultiRename|SelectionMore|ToolsAdopt"`): **238
tests in 29 suites, all passed** (FindFiles, Selection, Multi-Rename test classes, the three new Review2Find files,
ToolsAdopt). A second run of the plugin-command / remembered-listing / config / system-tools / Mac-integration /
file-ops-fix classes that use `SelectionPlugin()` with its default (background) mode: 17 tests, all passed. The same
area tests also passed repeatedly (5 runs of the new files) in a private package built from a snapshot of the pre-round
kernel/shell. Not run: ShellTests, the whole PluginTests target, TSan/ASan builds; the Spotlight query itself (needs a
live index).

## Not done

- A kernel bulk-marking API (cross-requests/find.md item 1): applying a long selection still costs the model's per-name
  lookups on the main thread, in pieces of 20,000; `selectAll`/`clearSelection` of everything and the kernel
  `invertSelection`/`restoreSelection` stay O(n) kernel calls on main for lists up to 20,000 (invert/restore above that
  are done off main).
- R011 (VirtualFolders), the SyncSession / CompareOperands part of R024 (DirectorySync, CompareContent).
- The first hit of a very large single folder still waits for that folder's listing and sort (providers list in batches
  but the results must come out in name order).
- Spotlight with a real index was not run (no test can rely on the index); the NSMetadataQuery operation-queue path is
  code-reviewed only.
- Multi-Rename: `RenamePlanner.steps` is serial and not cancellable; `foldsCase` still lists a folder a second time; the
  undo history stays in the settings (a file of its own needs a kernel settings API); "Undo identifies files by path
  only" is unchanged.
- One share mounted twice at different local mount points is not recognised as the same files by the duplicate finder.
- A FIFO that replaces a picture between the regular-file check and ImageIO's own open (`[T4]`) is not excluded.
